context: Aoi explains nutrition basics to Hina-young at the cafe.
purpose: Adult informally teaching teen about food.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 蒼さん、筋肉、ようけ食べたら付く?
lines.en: Aoi, if I eat lots of muscle food, will I get bigger muscles?
lines.style: Bright, curious rush of words. Leans forward slightly. The genuine enthusiasm of an 8-year-old who's just thought of something important. Soft warmth underneath—seeking reassurance as much as information.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 保健的に、健康な食事、大事ね。
lines.en: Well, health-wise, eating good food every day is really important.
lines.style: Warm, measured response. Settles into a patient, almost gentle rhythm. Not lecturing—more like sharing something she genuinely believes. Slight lift at the end, inviting understanding rather than demanding agreement.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 答えてもらえて、嬉しい。
lines.en: Thank you for answering me. That makes me really happy.
lines.style: Soft, genuine gratitude. No performance—this is real relief and happiness. Slight lift in the middle on 'really,' then settles. The unguarded sincerity of being truly heard by an adult.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 水も、よく飲んでね、毎日。
lines.en: And make sure you drink plenty of water every day, okay?
lines.style: Caring, specific guidance without pressure. Warm and attentive. Slight emphasis on 'plenty'—the gentle insistence of someone who notices details. A soft close, checking in rather than commanding.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 心配しないで、丁寧にやる!
lines.en: Don't worry—I'll do it really carefully!
lines.style: Bright, earnest commitment. Quick, assured pace. The determination of a child who wants to do things right. Small, genuine laugh underneath—proud to be trusted with this responsibility.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 良く考えて、無理せずね。
lines.en: Just think it through carefully, and don't push yourself too hard, alright?
lines.style: Tender, knowing caution. Slower pace. The wisdom of someone who's seen people hurt themselves with good intentions. Soft, caring—she's protecting Hina from her own enthusiasm without dampening it.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, energized gratitude. Quick pace, genuine smile in the voice. The uncomplicated joy of a child who's had a good conversation with a trusted adult. Clean, simple, radiates warmth.
